run_evaluate: run the TBLite evaluation environment CLI to benchmark terminal agents on the openthoughts-tblite dataset
run_evaluate_filter_tasks: run the TBLite evaluation with a task filter to evaluate only specific tasks like broken-python and pandas-etl
build_config_tblite: build a TBLiteEvalConfig instance with custom dataset name and task timeout settings
build_config_init: build TBLiteEvalEnv config and API server configs using the config_init class method
review_tblite_env: review the TBLiteEvalEnv class and its inherited evaluation logic from TerminalBench2EvalEnv
